name: Arajet
description: All white, with Arajet's parrot large on the white fin: a stylized parrot's head facing forward, a thick violet arc over its crown, a black eye, a violet crescent round a lighter violet cheek, and four rainbow feathers (cyan, yellow, orange, green) sweeping down and aft to the fin's root. 'arajet' in big heavy rounded violet lowercase across the forward windows ahead of the wing, the glass through its letters; small 'arajet.com' over the aft windows with the Dominican flag and the registration under it. Violet engine cowlings with bare inlet lips and violet winglets.

violet.name: Arajet violet (the title, the parrot's arc and crescent, cowlings, winglets)

logos.description: Arajet's parrot, large on the white fin, facing forward: a thick violet arc over the head from the leading edge to near the trailing edge, a black eye under it, a violet crescent wrapped round the front of a lighter violet rounded cheek (the beak's place), and four curved feathers fanning down and aft from behind the eye, cyan and yellow on top, then orange and green, the longest reaching the fin's root. Mirrored on the right side, so the parrot faces the nose on both.
A small Dominican flag (blue and red quarters with a white cross) just forward of the registration, under 'arajet.com'.

titles.style: Arajet's wordmark: big heavy rounded violet lowercase across the forward windows ahead of the wing (the glass through its letters); the j's tail drops well below the others and its dot rises above.
Small violet lowercase web address over the aft windows, ahead of the aft door.

notes: Measured on HI1098 (left, 2025-12-31) fitted to shapes/B38M.json and checked on HI1078 (right, 2026-02-20, flipped and fitted): 'arajet' x 0.217-0.368, baseline y -0.139, x-height top 0.39, ascenders 0.54 (cap height taken as the ascenders), the same stretch on the right side; 'arajet.com' x 0.737-0.795; the parrot centered at fin (0.52, 0.36), 0.78 of the fin tall, from the leading edge almost to the trailing edge. Not drawn: the registration in violet-black capitals under 'arajet.com' (on HI1098 x 0.755-0.794, y -0.12 to 0.0), each jet's name in small black italics under the cockpit (a Dominican place: 'Laguna Redonda, Miches' on HI1098, 'Los Tres Ojos' on HI1078, 'Los Haitises' on HI1101), what may be a small 'arajet' on the winglets' inner faces (HI1078, too small to read), the nose-gear door's number.
history: New 2026-11-26. Arajet, the Dominican Republic's low-cost airline, flies only Boeing 737 MAX 8s from Santo Domingo (first flight 2022-09); every photo since 2022 shows this scheme, except HI1101's flag scheme (DWI/dominican-flag).
